coder_notes: Multi-cancer first-in-human ADC trial. Conditions: Advanced Solid Tumors only; GBM is named once in inclusion criterion 3 (RANO 2.0 for GBM subjects) and in outcomes; coded basket_gbm_eligible with an uncertain flag. B7-H3 is explicitly not an entry requirement ('no minimum B7-H3 expression level mandatory'), so role exploratory_correlative. Enzalutamide and abiraterone coded soc_backbone: approved prostate-cancer hormone therapy combined with DB-1311 in expansion arms 16-18 (judgement call; could alternatively be experimental_combination, which would not change candidate status of DB-1311). Lopinavir/ritonavir and itraconazole are DDI perpetrators in an exclusively PK sub-study, coded supportive. Regimen coded combination because several experimental arms add enzalutamide or abiraterone; most arms are monotherapy. Plasma PK only.
